people.name: Antioch
people.line: A major city where the gospel spread to Gentiles.

people.name: Barnabas
people.line: A Levite from Cyprus who accompanied Paul on missionary journeys.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,
translations.bsb: When news of this reached the ears of the church in Jerusalem, they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
translations.kjv: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
translations.asv: And the report concerning them came to the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas as far as Antioch:
